description: A tool for module makers: put it immediately to the right of a module and it lays a screen and a set of guide lines over that module's panel

params.text: Sets the horizontal position of the guide being edited, -1500 to 1500 pixels; a negative value is measured from the right edge, which is how a right margin is made
Sets the vertical position of the guide being edited, -380 to 380 pixels; a negative value is measured from the bottom edge
Switches the guide being edited between Horizontal and Vertical
Sets the thickness of the guide being edited, 0 to 50 pixels
Repeats the guide being edited every so many pixels across the panel, 0 to 50; at 0 it is drawn once
Chooses whether the screen covers the panel only, or the knobs, jacks and displays as well; covering them stops that module from being used
Turns the screen and guides on the module to the left on and off

notes: this module draws nothing on itself: it works on the module immediately to its left, and only while the switch at the top left is on
the list filling the lower half of the panel holds the guides; click one to load it into the knobs for editing, and click a blank part of the list to stop editing it
the plus, minus and cross buttons add the current knob settings to the list, remove the selected guide, and empty the list; they are not parameters, so no click on them reaches this help
the row of small pictures adds a ready-made set of guides, and each set is added to what is already in the list rather than replacing it
the box under the template row names the guide about to be added; leave it empty and the module names it
the upper palette button sets the colour and transparency of the screen and the lower one the colour of the guide being edited; they are not parameters, so no click on them reaches this help
right-click any of these knobs to type an exact pixel value
the lamp in the title bar is lit while the guides are being drawn on a module
menu: Open... — in the hamburger menu at the end of the template row: reads a saved set of guides from a file
Save... — in the hamburger menu at the end of the template row: writes the current list of guides to a file
20px top margin — in the hamburger menu at the end of the template row: adds that ready-made set to the list
